title: Understanding Probability Sampling
text: Probability sampling involves selecting a sample in such a way that each member of the population has a known, non-zero chance of being selected. Can you identify how this applies to Zekai's proposal?

title: Random Selection in Groups
text: Consider how Zekai's method involves random selection within groups of students. How does this contribute to the probability sampling method?

title: Identifying the Sampling Method
text: Zekai's method involves selecting one student randomly from each group of seven. What type of sampling method does this represent?

title: Characteristics of Probability Sampling
text: Probability sampling ensures that every individual has a chance of being selected. How does Zekai's method ensure this?

title: Randomness in Sampling
text: Why is randomness important in Zekai's sampling method? Consider how it affects the representativeness of the sample.

title: Evaluating the Sampling Process
text: Does Zekai's method ensure that each student has an equal chance of being selected?
